title: Since Vs For
theory:
'Since' and 'For' are prepositions when they are used with time expressions.
                                                     Since/For

                               Point of time                             Period of time

             Note: Subject + is/am/are/was/were + V1+ing + Object + Since/for + time

                                  has/have/had+been

Use of Since                 Since- It is used to show a specific point of time in the past. (dc ls)
      $ Since + Name of the day               (Since Monday, Since Friday)
      $ Since + Name of the month             (Since March, Since April)
      $ Since + Parts of the day              (Since morning, Since evening, Since last night)
      $ Since + Name of the year              (Since 1947, Since 2020)
      $ Since + Name of the occasion          (Since Holi, Since marriage)
      $ Since + Time		                        (Since 5 o'clock, Since 2 PM)
      $ Since + Stage of life                 (Childhood, Teenage, Adolescence)
      $ Since + Date		                        (Since 5th March, Since 1st January)
      $ Since arrival, Since departure, Since inception, Since time immemorial, Since the
        beginning of + Noun
  Use of for                for- It is used to show duration/ period length of time (fdrus le; rd)

     $ For 2 hours, For 3 hours, For a long time, For several days, For a month, For a while,
       For an hour, For the last two weeks, For the past 3 years, for years.
